items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Hard-working man. Where was he from? [INTERVIEWEE] I guess he’s from Virginia. St. Paul, Virginia. I guess.

ctx.x: Yeah, at the same time. He was... I guess he was a playboy, whatever he was. Bigamist. Whatever he was. He had three sets of children.
Hard-working man. Where was he from?
I guess he’s from Virginia. St. Paul, Virginia. I guess.
